proposal: New interface IF-44 in IF-001; IG-04 condition 'ball cleaning in operation, debris filters clean'.
question: ER-07.03 requires an automatic ball-type tube cleaning system; IEC excludes it (DoR 4.2 = EPC). The EPC accepts the scope but needs the interface: ball injection and strainer nozzle positions and sizes, the CW-side pressure drop with debris filters, and confirmation that IG-04 assumes ball cleaning in operation.
response: Confirmed: ball cleaning and debris filters by EPC. Interface added as IF-44: two ball injection nozzles DN150 per inlet water box half, ball strainer at each outlet box DN1800 flange; CW-side pressure drop 0.62 bar clean condenser plus 0.15 bar per debris filter. IG-04 applies with ball cleaning in operation.
subject: Condenser tube cleaning balls and debris filters (E-03)
